title.value: Postdoctoral Fellowships at University of Oxford - 2027
title.evidence_quote: Postdoctoral Fellowships at University of Oxford - 2027 - Novo Nordisk Fonden

field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)
seniority: Postdoctoral (PhD within five years of start)
qualifications: PhD in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology obtained within five years of the start date
PhD students may apply if their supervisor confirms graduation before the start
Research collaboration set up with a University of Oxford group
Based in Denmark or intending to return to Denmark for the final phase
description_short: Novo Nordisk Foundation three-year postdoctoral fellowship: two years at the University of Oxford, then a final year at a Danish host institution, funded up to DKK 3.6 million. The call opened 30 September 2026 and closes 29 January 2027, 2:00pm Copenhagen time.

deadline.evidence_quote: closes 29 January 2027 at 2:00pm (Copenhagen time), after opening on 30 September 2026

compensation.value: Up to DKK 3.6 million per fellowship (about DKK 1.2 million per year)
compensation.evidence_quote: about DKK 1.2 million per year, up to DKK 3.6 million per fellowship
